items.html: No runtime mode-conditional — the mode is resolved & baked at start; the kernel never branches on it, there is no runtime mode field → by design

No run-level policy map / engine — there is no free-floating mode → policy selection; mode-specific policy lives in the gate binding where it runs (its config). A DRY central profile (one place to set a policy across many gates) is deferred until a concrete need → later
No mode expression DSL / overlay / patch / step-graph rewrite — the whole mechanism is a modes: membership tag; breadth is fenced by the mechanism, not by dropping a surface → by design

No mode on agent_config or on steps — v1 does not condition the model / agent_config or the step graph by mode; modes tag only gate bindings and context refs, and a tag anywhere else is rejected at load (mode_tag_on_unsupported_surface) → by design
No post-start mode change — mode is create-time immutable (v1 parity); a run does not switch variant mid-flight → by design
